title: One Tornado Stayed on the Ground for 219 Miles in 1925

scenes.text: One tornado stayed on the ground for 219 miles.
It was March 18, 1925. The Tri-State Tornado began in Missouri.
It crossed Illinois and Indiana without lifting for over three and a half hours.
It raced along at an average of 62 miles an hour, like a car on the highway.
Its winds neared 300 miles an hour, inside a funnel a mile wide.
It killed 695 people, the deadliest tornado in US history.

On March 18, 1925, the Tri-State Tornado tore across Missouri, Illinois and Indiana for more than three and a half hours at an average of 62 miles an hour. It killed 695 people, the deadliest tornado in US history.
